bagPolicy.summary: Only bags and purses smaller than 12″ x 12″ x 6″ are permitted inside Rogers Place after physical inspection.
allowed: bags and purses smaller than 12″ x 12″ x 6″
bagPolicy.note: To assist with entry into Rogers Place with a medically necessary bag, please contact the Ticketing & Customer Services Team in advance.

parking.note: Event parking is available through online reservations in surrounding lots and parkades. For more information, email transportation@rogersplace.com. Consider using transit or ride-share options for convenience.

rideshare.note: Rogers Place has several designated drop-off and pick-up locations for the general public and ride-share.

concessions.note: Rogers Place offers a diverse range of food and drink options across its main and upper concourses. Highlights include Butcher's Cuts, Market Perogies, and various bars such as the Truly Bar and Sipp Vodka Bar. Special offerings include the Molson Fan Deck and Mott's Caesar House.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Rogers Place, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Rogers Place's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Rogers Place. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Regular Season Edmonton Oilers Games – Doors open 60-minutes prior to game time. Regular Season Edmonton Oil Kings Games– Doors open 60-minutes prior to game time.
